		-- ScaleTextureLength attribute is true (default). False leaves authored value
		-- so tiles repeat more densely as beam grows.
		if ps.ScaleTextureLength ~= false then
			vb.TextureLength = (ap.TextureLength and vb.TextureLength or pData._baseTextureLength) * pFactor
		end
		vb.Segments = math.max(20, math.round((ap.Segments and vb.Segments or pData._baseSegments) * pFactor))
	end

	return isDying
end

end

--[[
	UpdateCommon  -  per-frame displacement helpers shared by the Part and Attachment update mixins
	(Update.luau, UpdateAttachment.luau). UpdateModel keeps its own variant.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local Turbulence = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)

-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z over-life graph → per-frame delta added to displacement.
-- Difference-based: sample absolute offset at t_norm in the DisplacementMode
-- frame, subtract _prevWorldOff. LocalCF accumulator integrates correctly.
-- Three frames mirror DirMode (Speed direction):
--   Global     = world axes (no rotation applied)
--   Local      = SpawnRotation (post-RotXYZ particle frame; per-particle RotXYZ
--                rotates the path → fans / scatter / convergence patterns)
--   RigidLocal = SpawnEmitterRotation (emitter frame at spawn, pre-RotXYZ;
--                path follows emitter orientation but not particle tumble)
-- Returns (delta, isLinkLocal). isLinkLocal is true when the offset is already in
-- link-local space (Local mode under a useVOS link) and so must NOT be VOS'd again —
-- see _composeLocalDelta. Otherwise the delta is in world/emitter space like before.
local function _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, steppedI, useVOS)
	if not (pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs or pData.HasTurbulence) then return Vector3.zero, false end
	local delta = Vector3.zero
	if pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs then
		local oX = pData._staticPosOffsetX or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX)) or 0
		local oY = pData._staticPosOffsetY or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY)) or 0
		local oZ = pData._staticPosOffsetZ or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ)) or 0
		local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
			pData.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation,
			pData._displacementMirrorX, pData._displacementMirrorY, pData._displacementMirrorZ)
		delta = worldOff - pData._prevWorldOff
		pData._prevWorldOff = worldOff
	end
	-- Turbulence keeps its own telescoping accumulator (_prevTurbOff): OnHit Bounce
	-- mirrors re-baseline only _prevWorldOff, and noise never mirrors.
	if pData.HasTurbulence then
		delta = delta + Turbulence.frameDelta(pData, steppedI)
	end
	-- Local mode's SpawnRotation is captured link-local under a link, so the delta is
	-- already link-local. Flag it so the apply site skips the second VOS that would
	-- precess it around a spinning Weld instead of letting the radius shrink.
	local isLinkLocal = useVOS and (pData.DisplacementMode or "Global") == "Local"
	return delta, isLinkLocal
end

-- Stack a frame's displacement into a link-local LocalCF accumulator. The world-built
-- velocity is VOS'd into link-local when welded; a link-local PosOffset is added as-is.
-- motionFactor scales the whole spatial delta (Speed + Accel + PosOffset) by the parent
-- Model's scale for nested particles (1 otherwise) — applied to the sum so it stays coherent.
local function _composeLocalDelta(parentCF, useVOS, velWorld, posDelta, posIsLinkLocal, motionFactor)
	if not useVOS then return (velWorld + posDelta) * motionFactor end
	local velLocal = parentCF:VectorToObjectSpace(velWorld)
	local posLocal = posIsLinkLocal and posDelta or parentCF:VectorToObjectSpace(posDelta)
	return (velLocal + posLocal) * motionFactor
end

local UpdateCommon = {}
UpdateCommon._posOffsetFrameDelta = _posOffsetFrameDelta
UpdateCommon._composeLocalDelta = _composeLocalDelta

return UpdateCommon

--[[
	UpdateModel Mixin  -  per-frame update for Model particles.
	Same motion branches as UpdatePart; uses :PivotTo for position and :ScaleTo for size.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)
local EventsCollision = require(script.Parent.EventsCollision)
local Turbulence = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors

-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z over-life graph → per-frame delta added to displacement.
-- Routes through Constants.resolveDisplacement so DisplacementMode (Global / Local /
-- RigidLocal) + OnHit mirror axes apply uniformly with the Part / Attachment path
-- in Update.luau:_posOffsetFrameDelta.
local function _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, steppedI)
	if not (pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs or pData.HasTurbulence) then return Vector3.zero end
	local delta = Vector3.zero
	if pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs then
		local oX = pData._staticPosOffsetX or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX)) or 0
		local oY = pData._staticPosOffsetY or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY)) or 0
		local oZ = pData._staticPosOffsetZ or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ)) or 0
		local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
			pData.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation,
			pData._displacementMirrorX, pData._displacementMirrorY, pData._displacementMirrorZ)
		delta = worldOff - pData._prevWorldOff
		pData._prevWorldOff = worldOff
	end
	-- Turbulence keeps its own accumulator (_prevTurbOff); see Update.luau twin.
	if pData.HasTurbulence then
		delta = delta + Turbulence.frameDelta(pData, steppedI)
	end
	return delta
end

return function(Particle)

-- Per-frame update for a Model-typed particle (`pData`). Advances effective elapsed,
-- writes the new pivot via :PivotTo, applies scale + flipbook. Returns true when the
-- particle has died (consumed by Engine.luau's swap-and-pop loop).
function Particle:UpdateModel(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse Timescale: see Update.luau UpdatePart. SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	dt = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dt)
	if dt < 0 and pData._hitHistory and #pData._hitHistory > 0 then
		EventsCollision.restoreHitsOnReverse(pData, priorEff, newEff)
	end
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	-- After-clamp dt: boundary frames see partial step instead of overshooting.
	dt = newEff - priorEff
	pData._lastEffectiveDt = dt
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	if pData._collisionStopped then return graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd) end
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	pData.AccumulatedDT += dt
	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)

	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		local prevStep = pData.CurrentStep
		local stepDir = (targetStep > prevStep) and 1 or -1
		local stepsToProcess = math.abs(targetStep - prevStep)
		local frameDT = pData.AccumulatedDT
		local perStepDT = frameDT / stepsToProcess
		pData.AccumulatedDT = 0

		-- Collision spin: angular velocity (deg/sec) into per-axis accumulators.
		local spinRate = pData._spinRate
		if spinRate and (spinRate.X ~= 0 or spinRate.Y ~= 0 or spinRate.Z ~= 0) then
			pData._spinAccumX = (pData._spinAccumX or 0) + spinRate.X * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumY = (pData._spinAccumY or 0) + spinRate.Y * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumZ = (pData._spinAccumZ or 0) + spinRate.Z * frameDT
		end
		local speedMult = pData.SpeedMultiplier or 1
		local spinAddX = pData._spinAccumX or 0
		local spinAddY = pData._spinAccumY or 0
		local spinAddZ = pData._spinAccumZ or 0
		local rotOrder = pData.RotOrder or "Global"

		-- POSITION: Inverted
		if pData.InvertMotion then
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
			local reverseStep = pData.TotalKeyFrames - targetStep
			local localCF = pData.SimLocalCFrames[reverseStep] or pData.SimLocalCFrames[0]
			local parentCF_now = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
			pData.VisualPart:PivotTo(parentCF_now * localCF)
			pData._localWorldCF = localCF
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart:GetPivot().Position

		-- POSITION: Forward, FULL iteration (VelocityVectored)
		elseif pData.NeedsFullIteration then
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero
			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime

				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				local draggedSpeed = hasDrag and (speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec)) or speed

				local displacement
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					displacement = (pData.BaseDirection * draggedSpeed + accelVel) * perStepDT
				else
					displacement = pData.BaseDirection * (draggedSpeed * perStepDT)
				end

				-- PosOffset per-step delta. Telescoping integration across loop iterations.
				displacement = displacement + _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, si)

				local parentCF_now, useVOS = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
				local parentLocalDelta = useVOS and parentCF_now:VectorToObjectSpace(displacement) or displacement
				pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * pData.LocalCF

				local rotDamp = pData._settleRotDamp or 1
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp

				local rotationCFrame
				if pData.RotMode == "Speed" then
					pData.AccRotX = pData.AccRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
					pData.AccRotY = pData.AccRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
					pData.AccRotZ = pData.AccRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, pData.AccRotX + spinAddX, pData.AccRotY + spinAddY, pData.AccRotZ + spinAddZ)
				else
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, rotSpeedX + spinAddX, rotSpeedY + spinAddY, rotSpeedZ + spinAddZ)
				end

				pData.VisualPart:PivotTo((parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF) * rotationCFrame)
				pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
				pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart:GetPivot().Position

				local rotatedCF = pData.VisualPart:GetPivot() * pData.SpreadRotation
				local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[pData.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
				pData.BaseDirection = rotatedCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep

		-- POSITION: Forward, SPEED ROTATION (accumulated rotation)
		elseif pData.NeedsRotAccum then
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				if hasDrag then speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec) end
				totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
				end

				local rotDamp = pData._settleRotDamp or 1
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp
				pData.AccRotX = pData.AccRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotY = pData.AccRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotZ = pData.AccRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp
			totalDisplacement = totalDisplacement + _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames)

			local parentCF_now, useVOS = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
			local parentLocalDelta = useVOS and parentCF_now:VectorToObjectSpace(totalDisplacement) or totalDisplacement
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * pData.LocalCF
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, pData.AccRotX + spinAddX, pData.AccRotY + spinAddY, pData.AccRotZ + spinAddZ)

			pData.VisualPart:PivotTo((parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF) * rotationCFrame)
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart:GetPivot().Position
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep

		-- POSITION: Forward, FAST (absolute rotation)
		else
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				if hasDrag then speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec) end
				totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
				end
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp
			totalDisplacement = totalDisplacement + _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames)

			local parentCF_now, useVOS = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
			local parentLocalDelta = useVOS and parentCF_now:VectorToObjectSpace(totalDisplacement) or totalDisplacement
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * pData.LocalCF

			local steppedI = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
			local rotDamp = pData._settleRotDamp or 1
			local rotX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
			local rotY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
			local rotZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, rotX + spinAddX, rotY + spinAddY, rotZ + spinAddZ)

			pData.VisualPart:PivotTo((parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF) * rotationCFrame)
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart:GetPivot().Position
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		end

		-- SCALE: ScaleTo cascades to BaseParts, Meshes, PEs, Beams, Trails.
		local steppedI = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
		local scale = math.max(0.001, pData._staticScale or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Scale, pData.Seeds.Scale))
		-- Published for nested children's chain (PartConstants.getParentScaleFactor).
		pData._ownScale = scale
		-- Nested Model: compound with the inherited parent-Model scale chain (1 if top-level).
		scale = scale * Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, currentTime, GraphMod)
		pData.VisualPart:ScaleTo(scale)
		-- ScaleTo can drop descendant Beam.Segments below 20; re-clamp.
		if pData._visualBeams then
			for _, beam in ipairs(pData._visualBeams) do
				if beam.Parent and beam.Segments < 20 then beam.Segments = 20 end
			end
		end
	end

	return isDying
end

end

--[[
	VisualHost  -  the one place that decides where runtime visuals live.
	Root = workspace.CurrentCamera: Team Create never replicates Camera descendants, so emitted
	clones, pooled clones, previews, screen effects and the distortion canvas stay local to the
	emitting user. A game server has a camera too and nothing under it reaches any player, so
	on a server the root is workspace.Terrain, which replicates; the same without a camera.
	Folders are re-parented, never recreated, when Studio swaps the camera, so live pData
	references stay valid. Anything parented elsewhere is user intent (EmitParent) or an engine
	constraint (Atmosphere renders only under Lighting).
	Carriers: invisible anchored Parts that mirror a user BasePart's CFrame every frame, so
	Attachment / Light visuals that used to live INSIDE the user's part keep parent-relative
	motion without replicating. Engine.step calls VisualHost.tick() before any particle update.
	Edit audio host: Studio plays a plugin's Sounds in edit mode only under a DockWidgetPluginGui.
	The plugin registers one (init.server.lua); games never do, so their Sounds stay positional.
]]

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local VisualHost = {}

local LEGACY_ROOT = workspace.Terrain
local FOLDER_NAMES = { live = "EmittedPartsUsingPart_icle", pool = "Part_IclesPooled", preview = "MotionPreview" }

local _folders = {}
local _cameraConn = nil
local _carriers = {}
local _editAudioHost = nil

-- True where the code runs as a server only: a live server, Studio's Run mode and the server
-- side of a play test. Studio edit mode and Team Create editing count as a client.
local function isServerOnly()
	return RunService:IsServer() and not RunService:IsClient()
end

-- The camera for a client or the editor, else Terrain (a server, or no camera); both keep
-- Workspace ancestry so Beams, Trails and BulkMoveTo keep working.
function VisualHost.root()
	if isServerOnly() then return LEGACY_ROOT end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if cam then return cam end
	return LEGACY_ROOT
end

-- Blur / Bloom / ColorCorrection render under the Camera (player-local); Atmosphere is
-- Lighting-only, and so is everything a server emits, for the same reason as root().
function VisualHost.screenEffectParent(kind)
	if kind == "Atmosphere" or isServerOnly() then return Lighting end
	return workspace.CurrentCamera or Lighting
end

local function watchCamera()
	if _cameraConn then return end
	_cameraConn = workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
		VisualHost.rehome()
	end)
end

-- Move every cached folder under the current root (camera swap). Destroyed folders are dropped
-- so the next accessor rebuilds them.
function VisualHost.rehome()
	local root = VisualHost.root()
	for key, folder in pairs(_folders) do
		if folder.Parent == nil then
			_folders[key] = nil
		elseif folder.Parent ~= root then
			pcall(function() folder.Parent = root end)
		end
	end
end

-- Find-or-create a runtime folder under the root. A folder left under Terrain by an older
-- version (or by a session that died) is adopted and re-parented, so nothing is duplicated.
local function ensureFolder(key)
	local folder = _folders[key]
	if folder and folder.Parent then return folder end
	local name = FOLDER_NAMES[key]
	local root = VisualHost.root()
	folder = root:FindFirstChild(name) or LEGACY_ROOT:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = name
		folder.Archivable = false
	end
	if folder.Parent ~= root then
		pcall(function() folder.Parent = root end)
	end
	_folders[key] = folder
	watchCamera()
	return folder
end

-- Live emit clones.
function VisualHost.getFolder()
	return ensureFolder("live")
end

-- Idle pool entries (Pool.release re-parents here so the Explorer shows what is recyclable).
function VisualHost.getPoolFolder()
	return ensureFolder("pool")
end

-- Motion Preview adornments.
function VisualHost.getPreviewFolder()
	return ensureFolder("preview")
end

-- Distortion canvas parts sit directly under the root.
function VisualHost.getCanvasParent()
	watchCamera()
	return VisualHost.root()
end

-- Set once by the plugin at load (init.server.lua); outlives Activate / Deactivate, so reset() keeps it.
function VisualHost.setEditAudioHost(host)
	_editAudioHost = host
end

-- The plugin's audio widget while it exists; nil in games (Sound emitters then play positionally).
function VisualHost.getEditAudioHost()
	if _editAudioHost and _editAudioHost.Parent then
		return _editAudioHost
	end
	return nil
end

-- Anchor pose: BasePart CFrame or Attachment WorldCFrame.
local function anchorCFrame(anchor)
	if anchor:IsA("Attachment") then return anchor.WorldCFrame end
	return anchor.CFrame
end

-- Carrier: an invisible anchored Part under the live folder that tracks `anchor` (BasePart or
-- Attachment) each frame. Released by _releaseOrDestroy through releaseCarrier; never pooled.
function VisualHost.acquireCarrier(anchor)
	local carrier = Instance.new("Part")
	carrier.Name = "_Carrier"
	carrier.Anchored = true
	carrier.CanCollide = false
	carrier.CanQuery = false
	carrier.CanTouch = false
	carrier.CastShadow = false
	carrier.Transparency = 1
	carrier.Size = anchor:IsA("BasePart") and anchor.Size or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	carrier.CFrame = anchorCFrame(anchor)
	carrier.Archivable = false
	carrier:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	carrier.Parent = VisualHost.getFolder()
	_carriers[carrier] = anchor
	return carrier
end

function VisualHost.releaseCarrier(carrier)
	if not carrier then return end
	_carriers[carrier] = nil
	pcall(function() carrier:Destroy() end)
end

-- Per-frame mirror. Runs before particle updates so parent-relative math reads this frame's pose.
-- A destroyed anchor freezes its carrier in place (the particle keeps its last parent frame).
function VisualHost.tick()
	if next(_carriers) == nil then return end
	for carrier, anchor in pairs(_carriers) do
		if carrier.Parent == nil then
			_carriers[carrier] = nil
		elseif anchor.Parent ~= nil then
			carrier.CFrame = anchorCFrame(anchor)
		end
	end
end

-- Deactivate: destroy every runtime folder + carrier and stop watching the camera.
function VisualHost.reset()
	if _cameraConn then
		_cameraConn:Disconnect()
		_cameraConn = nil
	end
	for carrier in pairs(_carriers) do
		pcall(function() carrier:Destroy() end)
	end
	table.clear(_carriers)
	for key, folder in pairs(_folders) do
		if folder.Parent then pcall(function() folder:Destroy() end) end
		_folders[key] = nil
	end
	-- Folders a previous version left under Terrain.
	for _, name in pairs(FOLDER_NAMES) do
		local stale = LEGACY_ROOT:FindFirstChild(name)
		if stale then pcall(function() stale:Destroy() end) end
	end
end

return VisualHost

--[[
	ZOffset Mixin  -  per-frame position shift along particle→camera line for Part / Model / Attachment.
	Positive = closer to camera. Runs after Orientation so velocity derivation uses pre-shifted position.
]]

return function(Particle)

local EPS = 1e-3

function Particle:ApplyZOffset(pData, camPos)
	local zo = pData.ZOffset
	if not zo or zo == 0 then return end
	if not camPos then return end
	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return end
	local t = pData.Type
	if t ~= "Part" and t ~= "Model" and t ~= "Attachment" then return end

	local isModel = t == "Model"
	local isAttachment = t == "Attachment"
	-- Use the pre-overlay base CFrame so ZOffset is an absolute shift; reading live would compound each frame.
	local currentCF = pData._postUpdateCF or (isModel and pData.VisualPart:GetPivot() or pData.VisualPart.CFrame)

	-- Attachment.CFrame is parent-local; convert to world for the camera shift, back to local on write.
	local parentPart
	if isAttachment then
		parentPart = pData.VisualPart.Parent
		if parentPart and parentPart:IsA("BasePart") then
			currentCF = parentPart.CFrame * currentCF
		else
			parentPart = nil
		end
	end

	local pos = currentCF.Position
	local toCam = camPos - pos
	local mag = toCam.Magnitude
	if mag < EPS then return end
	local newPos = pos + (toCam / mag) * zo
	local newCF = CFrame.new(newPos) * (currentCF - pos)

	if parentPart then
		newCF = parentPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(newCF)
	end

	if isModel then
		pData.VisualPart:PivotTo(newCF)
	else
		pData.VisualPart.CFrame = newCF
	end
end

end

--!native
--!optimize 2

local Types = require(script.Types)

local chunkReaders = require(script.chunks)
local crc32 = require(script.crc32)
local zlib = require(script.zlib)

local COLOR_TYPE_CHANNELS = {
	[0] = 1,
	[2] = 3,
	[3] = 1,
	[4] = 2,
	[6] = 4,
}

local INTERLACE_ROW_START = { 0, 0, 4, 0, 2, 0, 1 }
local INTERLACE_COL_START = { 0, 4, 0, 2, 0, 1, 0 }
local INTERLACE_ROW_INCR = { 8, 8, 8, 4, 4, 2, 2 }
local INTERLACE_COL_INCR = { 8, 8, 4, 4, 2, 2, 1 }

-- https://github.com/Kampfkarren/selene/issues/584
-- selene: allow(bad_string_escape)
local SIGNATURE = "\x89PNG\x0D\x0A\x1A\x0A"

export type PNG = Types.PNG

export type DecodeOptions = {
	allowIncorrectCRC: boolean?,
}

export type EncodeOptions = {
	width: number,
	height: number,
}

local function decode(buf: buffer, options: DecodeOptions?): PNG
	local bufLen = buffer.len(buf)
	assert(bufLen >= 8, "not a PNG")
	assert(buffer.readstring(buf, 0, 8) == SIGNATURE, "not a PNG")

	local chunks: { Types.Chunk } = table.create(3) -- minimal: IHDR, IDAT, IEND
	local offset = 8

	local skipCRC = options ~= nil and options.allowIncorrectCRC == true
	repeat
		local dataLength = bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(buf, offset))
		local chunkType = buffer.readstring(buf, offset + 4, 4)
		assert(string.match(chunkType, "%a%a%a%a"), `invalid chunk type {chunkType}`)

		local dataOffset = offset + 8
		local nextOffset = dataOffset + dataLength + 4
		assert(nextOffset <= bufLen, `EOF while reading {chunkType} chunk`)

		local chunkCode = bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(buf, nextOffset - 4))
		local expectCode = crc32(buf, offset + 4, nextOffset - 5)
		assert(skipCRC or chunkCode == expectCode, `incorrect checksum in {chunkType}`)

		table.insert(chunks, {
			type = chunkType,
			offset = dataOffset,
			length = dataLength,
		})
		offset = nextOffset
	until offset >= bufLen
	assert(offset == bufLen, "trailing data in file")

	for _, chunk in chunks do
		local t = chunk.type
		if bit32.extract(string.byte(t, 1, 1), 5) == 0 then
			if t ~= "IHDR" and t ~= "IDAT" and t ~= "PLTE" and t ~= "IEND" then
				error(`unhandled critical chunk {t}`)
			end
		end
	end

	local header: Types.IHDRChunk
	local headerChunk = chunks[1]
	assert(headerChunk.type == "IHDR", "first chunk must be IHDR")
	for i = 2, #chunks do
		assert(chunks[i].type ~= "IHDR", "multiple IHDR chunks are not allowed")
	end
	header = chunkReaders.IHDR(buf, headerChunk)

	local dataChunkIndex0 = -1
	local dataChunkIndex1 = -1
	local compressedDataLength = 0
	for i, chunk in chunks do
		if chunk.type == "IDAT" then
			if dataChunkIndex0 < 0 then
				dataChunkIndex0 = i
			else
				assert(i == dataChunkIndex1 + 1, "multiple IDAT chunks must be consecutive")
			end
			dataChunkIndex1 = i
			compressedDataLength += chunk.length
		end
	end
	assert(dataChunkIndex0 > 0, "no IDAT chunks")
	assert(compressedDataLength > 0, "no image data in IDAT chunks")

	local palette: Types.PLTEChunk?
	local paletteChunkIndex = -1
	for i, chunk in chunks do
		if chunk.type == "PLTE" then
			assert(not palette, "multiple PLTE chunks are not allowed")
			assert(i < dataChunkIndex0, "PLTE not allowed after IDAT chunks")
			assert(header.colorType ~= 0 and header.colorType ~= 4, "PLTE not allowed for color type")
			palette = chunkReaders.PLTE(buf, chunk, header)
			paletteChunkIndex = i
		end
	end
	if header.colorType == 3 then
		assert(palette ~= nil, "color type requires a PLTE chunk")
	end

	local transparencyData: Types.tRNSChunk?
	for i, chunk in chunks do
		if chunk.type == "tRNS" then
			assert(transparencyData == nil, "multiple tRNS chunks are not allowed")
			assert(i < dataChunkIndex0, "tRNS not allowed after IDAT chunks")
			assert(not palette or i > paletteChunkIndex, "tRNS must be after PLTE")
			assert(header.colorType ~= 4 and header.colorType ~= 6, "tRNS not allowed for color type")
			transparencyData = chunkReaders.tRNS(buf, chunk, header, palette)
		end
	end

	local finalChunk = chunks[#chunks]
	assert(finalChunk.type == "IEND", "final chunk must be IEND")
	assert(finalChunk.length == 0, "IEND chunk must be empty")
	for i = 2, #chunks - 1 do
		assert(chunks[i].type ~= "IEND", "multiple IEND chunks are not allowed")
	end

	local compressedData = buffer.create(compressedDataLength)
	local compressedOffset = 0
	for _, chunk in chunks do
		if chunk.type == "IDAT" then
			buffer.copy(compressedData, compressedOffset, buf, chunk.offset, chunk.length)
			compressedOffset += chunk.length
		end
	end

	local width = header.width
	local height = header.height
	local bitDepth = header.bitDepth
	local colorType = header.colorType
	local channels = COLOR_TYPE_CHANNELS[colorType]

	local rawSize = 0
	if not header.interlaced then
		rawSize = height * (math.ceil(width * channels * bitDepth / 8) + 1)
	else
		for i = 1, 7 do
			local w = math.ceil((width - INTERLACE_COL_START[i]) / INTERLACE_COL_INCR[i])
			local h = math.ceil((height - INTERLACE_ROW_START[i]) / INTERLACE_ROW_INCR[i])
			if w > 0 and h > 0 then
				local scanlineSize = math.ceil(w * channels * bitDepth / 8) + 1
				rawSize += h * scanlineSize
			end
		end
	end

	local paletteColors
	if palette then
		paletteColors = palette.colors
	end

	local rescale
	if colorType ~= 3 and bitDepth < 8 then
		rescale = 0xFF / (2 ^ bitDepth - 1)
	end

	local bpp = math.ceil(channels * bitDepth / 8)
	local defaultAlpha = 2 ^ bitDepth - 1

	local idx = 0
	local working = buffer.create(rawSize)
	local inflatedSize = zlib.inflate(compressedData, working)
	assert(inflatedSize == rawSize, "decompressed data size mismatch")

	local rgba8 = buffer.create(width * height * 4)

	local alphaGray = if transparencyData then transparencyData.gray else -1
	local alphaRed = if transparencyData then transparencyData.red else -1
	local alphaGreen = if transparencyData then transparencyData.green else -1
	local alphaBlue = if transparencyData then transparencyData.blue else -1

	local function pass(sx: number, sy: number, dx: number, dy: number)
		local w = math.ceil((width - sx) / dx)
		local h = math.ceil((height - sy) / dy)
		if w < 1 or h < 1 then
			return
		end

		local scanlineSize = math.ceil(w * channels * bitDepth / 8)
		local newIdx = idx

		for y = 1, h do
			local rowFilter = buffer.readu8(working, idx)
			idx += 1

			if rowFilter == 0 or (rowFilter == 2 and y == 1) then
				idx += scanlineSize
			elseif rowFilter == 1 then
				for x = 1, scanlineSize do
					local sub = if x <= bpp then 0 else buffer.readu8(working, idx - bpp)
					local value = bit32.band(buffer.readu8(working, idx) + sub, 0xFF)
					buffer.writeu8(working, idx, value)
					idx += 1
				end
			elseif rowFilter == 2 then
				for _ = 1, scanlineSize do
					local up = buffer.readu8(working, idx - scanlineSize - 1)
					local value = bit32.band(buffer.readu8(working, idx) + up, 0xFF)
					buffer.writeu8(working, idx, value)
					idx += 1
				end
			elseif rowFilter == 3 then
				for x = 1, scanlineSize do
					local sub = if x <= bpp then 0 else buffer.readu8(working, idx - bpp)
					local up = if y == 1 then 0 else buffer.readu8(working, idx - scanlineSize - 1)
					local value = bit32.band(buffer.readu8(working, idx) + bit32.rshift(sub + up, 1), 0xFF)
					buffer.writeu8(working, idx, value)
					idx += 1
				end
			elseif rowFilter == 4 then
				for x = 1, scanlineSize do
					local sub = if x <= bpp then 0 else buffer.readu8(working, idx - bpp)
					local up = if y == 1 then 0 else buffer.readu8(working, idx - scanlineSize - 1)
					local corner = if x <= bpp or y == 1
						then 0
						else buffer.readu8(working, idx - scanlineSize - bpp - 1)
					local p0 = math.abs(up - corner)
					local p1 = math.abs(sub - corner)
					local p2 = math.abs(sub + up - 2 * corner)
					local paeth = if p0 <= p1 and p0 <= p2 then sub elseif p1 <= p2 then up else corner
					local value = bit32.band(buffer.readu8(working, idx) + paeth, 0xFF)
					buffer.writeu8(working, idx, value)
					idx += 1
				end
			else
				error("invalid row filter")
			end
		end

		local bit = 8
		local function readValue()
			local b = buffer.readu8(working, newIdx)
			if bitDepth < 8 then
				b = bit32.extract(b, bit - bitDepth, bitDepth)
				bit -= bitDepth
				if bit == 0 then
					bit = 8
					newIdx += 1
				end
			elseif bitDepth == 8 then
				newIdx += 1
			else
				b = bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(b, 8), buffer.readu8(working, newIdx + 1))
				newIdx += 2
			end
			return b
		end

		for y = 1, h do
			newIdx += 1
			if bit < 8 then
				bit = 8
				newIdx += 1
			end

			for x = 1, w do
				local r, g, b, a

				if colorType == 0 then
					local gray = readValue()
					r = gray
					g = gray
					b = gray
					a = if gray == alphaGray then 0 else defaultAlpha
				elseif colorType == 2 then
					r = readValue()
					g = readValue()
					b = readValue()
					a = if r == alphaRed and g == alphaGreen and b == alphaBlue then 0 else defaultAlpha
				elseif colorType == 3 then
					local color = paletteColors[readValue() + 1]
					r = color.r
					g = color.g
					b = color.b
					a = color.a
				elseif colorType == 4 then
					local gray = readValue()
					r = gray
					g = gray
					b = gray
					a = readValue()
				elseif colorType == 6 then
					r = readValue()
					g = readValue()
					b = readValue()
					a = readValue()
				end

				local py = sy + (y - 1) * dy
				local px = sx + (x - 1) * dx
				local i = (py * width + px) * 4

				if rescale then
					r = math.round(r * rescale)
					g = math.round(g * rescale)
					b = math.round(b * rescale)
					a = math.round(a * rescale)
				elseif bitDepth == 16 then
					r = bit32.rshift(r, 8)
					g = bit32.rshift(g, 8)
					b = bit32.rshift(b, 8)
					a = bit32.rshift(a, 8)
				end

				buffer.writeu32(rgba8, i, bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(a, 24), bit32.lshift(b, 16), bit32.lshift(g, 8), r))
			end
		end
	end

	if not header.interlaced then
		pass(0, 0, 1, 1)
	else
		for i = 1, 7 do
			pass(INTERLACE_COL_START[i], INTERLACE_ROW_START[i], INTERLACE_COL_INCR[i], INTERLACE_ROW_INCR[i])
		end
	end

	local function readPixel(x: number, y: number)
		assert(x >= 1 and x <= width and y >= 1 and y <= height, "pixel out of range")

		local i = ((y - 1) * width + x - 1) * 4
		return buffer.readu8(rgba8, i),
			buffer.readu8(rgba8, i + 1),
			buffer.readu8(rgba8, i + 2),
			buffer.readu8(rgba8, i + 3)
	end

	return {
		width = width,
		height = height,
		pixels = rgba8,
		readPixel = readPixel,
	}
end

local function encode(pixels: buffer, options: EncodeOptions): buffer
	local width = options.width
	local height = options.height

	local dataSize = buffer.len(pixels)
	local expectSize = width * height * 4
	assert(dataSize == expectSize, `expected {expectSize} bytes, got {dataSize} bytes`)

	local imageDataRowSize = width * 4 + 1
	local imageData = buffer.create(height * imageDataRowSize)
	for row = 0, height - 1 do
		local sourceOffset = row * width * 4
		local targetOffset = row * imageDataRowSize
		buffer.writeu8(imageData, targetOffset, 0) -- filter method = 0
		buffer.copy(imageData, targetOffset + 1, pixels, sourceOffset, 4 * width)
	end

	local imageDataDeflated, imageDataDeflatedLength = zlib.deflate(imageData)
	local outputLength = 8 -- signature
		+ 25 -- IHDR
		+ (8 + imageDataDeflatedLength + 4) -- IDAT
		+ 12 -- IEND

	local output = buffer.create(outputLength)
	buffer.writestring(output, 0, SIGNATURE)

	-- IHDR
	buffer.writeu32(output, 8, bit32.byteswap(13)) -- chunk length
	buffer.writestring(output, 12, "IHDR")
	buffer.writeu32(output, 16, bit32.byteswap(width))
	buffer.writeu32(output, 20, bit32.byteswap(height))
	buffer.writeu8(output, 24, 8) -- 8-bit depth
	buffer.writeu8(output, 25, 6) -- rgba color
	buffer.writeu8(output, 26, 0) -- deflate compression
	buffer.writeu8(output, 27, 0) -- adaptive filtering
	buffer.writeu8(output, 28, 0) -- non-interlaced
	buffer.writeu32(output, 29, bit32.byteswap(crc32(output, 12, 28)))

	-- IDAT
	buffer.writeu32(output, 33, bit32.byteswap(imageDataDeflatedLength))
	buffer.writestring(output, 37, "IDAT")
	buffer.copy(output, 41, imageDataDeflated, 0, imageDataDeflatedLength)
	local x = 41 + imageDataDeflatedLength
	buffer.writeu32(output, x, bit32.byteswap(crc32(output, 37, x - 1)))

	-- IEND
	buffer.writeu32(output, x + 4, 0)
	buffer.writestring(output, x + 8, "IEND")
	buffer.writeu32(output, x + 12, 0x826042AE)

	return output
end

return {
	decode = decode,
	encode = encode,
}

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)

local COLOR_TYPE_BIT_DEPTH = {
	[0] = { 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 },
	[2] = { 8, 16 },
	[3] = { 1, 2, 4, 8 },
	[4] = { 8, 16 },
	[6] = { 8, 16 },
}

local function read(buf: buffer, chunk: Types.Chunk): Types.IHDRChunk
	assert(chunk.length == 13, "IHDR data must be 13 bytes")

	local offset = chunk.offset

	local width = bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(buf, offset))
	local height = bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(buf, offset + 4))
	local bitDepth = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 8)
	local colorType = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 9)
	local compression = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 10)
	local filter = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 11)
	local interlace = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 12)

	assert(width > 0 and width <= 2 ^ 31 and height > 0 and height <= 2 ^ 31, "invalid dimensions")
	assert(compression == 0, "invalid compression method")
	assert(filter == 0, "invalid filter method")
	assert(interlace == 0 or interlace == 1, "invalid interlace method")

	local allowedBitDepth = COLOR_TYPE_BIT_DEPTH[colorType]
	assert(allowedBitDepth ~= nil, "invalid color type")
	assert(table.find(allowedBitDepth, bitDepth) ~= nil, "invalid bit depth")

	return {
		width = width,
		height = height,
		bitDepth = bitDepth,
		colorType = colorType,
		interlaced = interlace == 1,
	}
end

return read

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)

local function read(buf: buffer, chunk: Types.Chunk, header: Types.IHDRChunk): Types.PLTEChunk
	assert(chunk.length % 3 == 0, "malformed PLTE chunk")

	local count = chunk.length / 3
	assert(count > 0, "no entries in PLTE")
	assert(count <= 256, "too many entries in PLTE")
	assert(count <= 2 ^ header.bitDepth, "too many entries in PLTE for bit depth")

	local colors = table.create(count)
	local offset = chunk.offset

	for i = 1, count do
		colors[i] = {
			r = buffer.readu8(buf, offset),
			g = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 1),
			b = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 2),
			a = 255,
		}
		offset += 3
	end

	return {
		colors = colors,
	}
end

return read

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)

local function readU16(buf: buffer, offset: number, depth: number)
	return bit32.extract(
		bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(buffer.readu8(buf, offset), 8), buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 1)),
		0,
		depth
	)
end

local function read(
	buf: buffer,
	chunk: Types.Chunk,
	header: Types.IHDRChunk,
	palette: Types.PLTEChunk?
): Types.tRNSChunk
	local gray = -1
	local red = -1
	local green = -1
	local blue = -1

	if header.colorType == 0 then
		assert(chunk.length == 2, "invalid tRNS length for color type")
		gray = readU16(buf, chunk.offset, header.bitDepth)
	elseif header.colorType == 2 then
		assert(chunk.length == 6, "invalid tRNS length for color type")
		red = readU16(buf, chunk.offset, header.bitDepth)
		green = readU16(buf, chunk.offset + 2, header.bitDepth)
		blue = readU16(buf, chunk.offset + 4, header.bitDepth)
	else
		local count = chunk.length -- 1 byte per transparency entry
		assert(palette, "tRNS requires PLTE for color type")
		assert(count <= #palette.colors, "tRNS specified too many PLTE alphas")
		for i = 1, count do
			palette.colors[i].a = buffer.readu8(buf, chunk.offset + i - 1)
		end
	end

	return {
		gray = gray,
		red = red,
		green = green,
		blue = blue,
	}
end

return read

local WINDOW_SEARCH = 0x8000 - WINDOW_LOOKAHEAD

local MAX_CHAIN_SEARCH = 12
local MAX_MATCH_LENGTH = 96
local DEFLATE_BLOCK_SIZE = 0x8000

type HuffmanTable = { number }

local function createHuffmanTable(lengths: { number }): (HuffmanTable, { number }, { number })
	local lengthCount = table.create(MAX_BITS, 0)
	lengthCount[0] = 0
	for _, length in lengths do
		if length > 0 then
			lengthCount[length] = (lengthCount[length] or 0) + 1
		end
	end

	local lastCode = 1
	local nextCode = table.create(MAX_BITS)
	for bits = 1, MAX_BITS do
		lastCode = bit32.lshift(lastCode + lengthCount[bits - 1], 1)
		nextCode[bits] = lastCode
	end

	local mapping = {}
	local codeValues = {}
	local codeLengths = {}
	for i, length in lengths do
		if length > 0 then
			mapping[nextCode[length]] = i - 1
			codeValues[i - 1] = bit32.extract(nextCode[length], 0, length)
			codeLengths[i - 1] = length
			nextCode[length] += 1
		end
	end

	return mapping, codeValues, codeLengths
end

local function getStoreSize(blockSize: number)

-- zlib adler32 applies modulo every 5552 cycles to keep s0 and s1 inside the 32-bit limit
-- however, using doubles allows us to wait >8.4m cycles in the worst case
local function adler32(input: buffer, offset: number, length: number): number
	local s0 = 1
	local s1 = 0
	local count = 0
	for i = offset, offset + length - 1 do
		s0 += buffer.readu8(input, i)
		s1 += s0
		count += 1
		if count == 8_400_000 then
			s0 %= 65521
			s1 %= 65521
			count = 0
		end
	end
	return bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(s1 % 65521, 16), s0 % 65521)
end

local function inflate(input: buffer, output: buffer): number

					elseif code == 17 then

					local repeatCount = 1
					if code <= 15 then
						distLength = code
					elseif code == 16 then
						repeatCount = readBits(2) + 3
					elseif code == 17 then
						distLength = 0
						repeatCount = readBits(3) + 3
					elseif code == 18 then
						distLength = 0

		end
	end

	local function getLitOrLenSize(value: number)
		return fixedLitCodeLengths[value]
	end

	local function getBackRefSize(distance: number, length: number)
		local distIdx = getDistIdx(distance)
		return getLitOrLenSize(cachedLitValues[length])

			+ fixedDistCodeLengths[distIdx - 1]

	local offsets = {}
	local nexts = {}
	local heads = {}
	local nodeCount = 0

	local function insertNode(offset: number, nextIndex: number)
		nodeCount += 1
		offsets[nodeCount] = offset
		nexts[nodeCount] = nextIndex
		return nodeCount
	end

	local function clearTables()
		table.clear(offsets)
		table.clear(nexts)
		table.clear(heads)
		nodeCount = 0
	end

	for startReadOffset = 0, inputSize - 1, DEFLATE_BLOCK_SIZE do
		local huffmanSizeBits = 0

		local nextBlockReadOffset = math.min(inputSize, startReadOffset + DEFLATE_BLOCK_SIZE)

			local hash = bit32.band(buffer.readu32(input, readOffset), 0xFFFFFF)
			local newNodeIndex = insertNode(readOffset, heads[hash] or 0)
			heads[hash] = newNodeIndex

			local bestLength = 0
			local bestOffset = -1

			local chainCount = 0
			local nodeIndex = nexts[newNodeIndex]
			while
				nodeIndex
				and (offsets[nodeIndex] or -math.huge) >= readOffset - WINDOW_SEARCH
				and chainCount < MAX_CHAIN_SEARCH
				and bestLength < MAX_MATCH_LENGTH
			do
				local searchLength = 3
				local searchOffset = offsets[nodeIndex]

				local exit = false
				local limit = math.min(nextBlockReadOffset, readOffset + WINDOW_LOOKAHEAD)
				if
					readOffset + bestLength < limit
					and buffer.readu8(input, searchOffset + bestLength)
						~= buffer.readu8(input, readOffset + bestLength)
				then
					exit = true -- pre-check the next byte after longest (early exit)
				end

				while
					not exit
					and searchLength < WINDOW_LOOKAHEAD
					and readOffset + searchLength < nextBlockReadOffset
					and buffer.readu8(input, searchOffset + searchLength)
						== buffer.readu8(input, readOffset + searchLength)
				do
					searchLength += 1
				end
				if searchLength > bestLength then
					bestLength = searchLength
					bestOffset = searchOffset
					if bestLength >= WINDOW_LOOKAHEAD then
						break
					end
				end
				nodeIndex = nexts[nodeIndex]
				chainCount += 1
			end

			if bestLength == 0 then
				local b = buffer.readu8(input, readOffset)
				huffmanSizeBits += getLitOrLenSize(b)
				table.insert(tokens, vector.create(0, b))
				readOffset += 1
			else
				huffmanSizeBits += getBackRefSize(readOffset - bestOffset, bestLength)
				table.insert(tokens, vector.create(1, readOffset - bestOffset, bestLength))
				for newOffset = readOffset + 1, math.min(readOffset + bestLength - 1, nextBlockReadOffset - 4) do
					local newHash = bit32.band(buffer.readu32(input, newOffset), 0xFFFFFF)
					heads[newHash] = insertNode(newOffset, heads[newHash] or 0)
				end
				readOffset += bestLength
			end
		end

		while readOffset < nextBlockReadOffset do
			local b = buffer.readu8(input, readOffset)
			huffmanSizeBits += getLitOrLenSize(b)
			table.insert(tokens, vector.create(0, b))
			readOffset += 1
		end

		huffmanSizeBits += getLitOrLenSize(0x100)
		table.insert(tokens, vector.create(0, 0x100))

		if nextBlockReadOffset == inputSize then
			writeBits(0b1, 1)
		else
			writeBits(0b0, 1)
		end

		local blockLength = nextBlockReadOffset - startReadOffset
		local fixedHuffmanSize = math.ceil(huffmanSizeBits / 8) + 1 -- bfinal/btype overhead
		if fixedHuffmanSize < getStoreSize(blockLength) then
			writeBits(0b01, 2)
			for _, token in tokens do
				if token.x == 0 then
					writeLitOrLen(token.y)
				else
					writeBackRef(token.y, token.z)
				end
			end
		else
			writeBits(0b00, 2)
			if writeOffsetBits > 0 then
				writeOffset += 1
				writeOffsetBits = 0
			end
			buffer.writeu16(output, writeOffset, blockLength)
			buffer.writeu16(output, writeOffset + 2, bit32.bxor(0xFFFF, blockLength))
			buffer.copy(output, writeOffset + 4, input, startReadOffset, blockLength)
			writeOffset += 4 + blockLength
		end

		if nodeCount > MAX_CHAIN_NODES then
			clearTables()
		end
	end

	if writeOffsetBits > 0 then
		writeOffset += 1
	end

	local checksum = adler32(input, 0, buffer.len(input))
	buffer.writeu32(output, writeOffset, bit32.byteswap(checksum))

	return output, writeOffset + 4
end

	inflate = inflate,
	deflate = deflate,
}
